name: Switchgear Solutions Ltd. (SSL)
old_description: SSL specializes in the design, application, sales, and support of electrical equipment for the industrial, commercial, & renewable markets.  We have the knowledge, relationships, and resources to drive power distribution and motor control projects from inception to completion.  Each engineered solution we provide to our customers is tailored to fulfill a specific need, built on a foundation of trust and collaboration, and solidly grounded by our extensive practical experience.
about:
Switchgear Solutions Ltd. (SSL) was established in 2004 in Lancaster, Pennsylvania, as a small manufacturers' representative for switchgear and transformers. The company later added the Substation Solutions Ltd. business name as it expanded its scope.

SSL provides design, application, sales, and support of electrical equipment for industrial, commercial, and renewable markets. Its services include engineering and testing, retrofit applications, power system studies, high‑voltage substation design, and design/build project execution. By 2015 the firm had grown to 18 employees across three offices in the Mid‑Atlantic region; it subsequently refocused on engineered solutions and design/build work rather than traditional bid‑and‑spec projects.

The company serves industrial, commercial, and renewable‑energy customers, delivering projects ranging from 500 kV substations to 460 V custom variable‑frequency‑drive solutions. SSL acts as a single point of contact from initial concept through final commissioning.

SSL emphasizes hands‑on involvement, quick and cost‑effective execution, and attention to detail as its key differentiators, aiming to provide cost‑benefit value on every project.
